name: Abai Qunanbaiuly
contribution: A Kazakh poet, composer and Hanafi Maturidi theologian philosopher.
legacy: This person was a cultural reformer toward European and Russian cultures on the basis of enlightened Islam.

checks.lead: Abai Qūnanbaiūly (10 August [O.S. 29 July] 1845 – 6 July [O.S. 23 June] 1904) was a Kazakh poet, composer and Hanafi Maturidi theologian philosopher.
